title: Level data
description: One playable location. Everything a level needs that is not code: where the player starts, where the puzzle markers are, which reusable puzzle type each marker opens, and which precomputed astronomy data it reads.

id.description: Stable level id, kebab-case. Used as the localStorage progress key.

displayName.description: Content key, never literal text. Bulgarian strings live in content/bg/.

mode.description: guided = linear tutorial (Earth, Moon). open = free exploration with scattered markers.

unlockThreshold.description: Fraction of this level's REQUIRED markers that must be solved to unlock the next page — solved intersected with required, so optional markers can never carry a level on their own. 1.0 for guided levels, 0.7 for open ones — the brief's forgiving gate, kept as data so both kinds share one code path.

markers.description: Puzzle stations. The brief calls for roughly 3-4 per level.

contentKey.description: ASCII key resolved through src/shared/content.ts. A literal Cyrillic string here is a bug.

rotateMatchConfig.description: The one engine that exists. Four Earth beats reskin it — sundial, day/night spin, seasons tilt, moon phase — so its config is pinned here rather than left free-form.

targets.description: How many rounds the child plays before the marker is solved. Zero rounds would be solved before it is touched.

tolerance.description: How close counts as matched, in the renderer's own units. Must be positive — a zero tolerance demands an exact drag, which is the opposite of the brief's forgiving gate.

noEngineConfig.description: No engine exists for this type yet, so no config shape is known. Absent or empty is the only honest value; guessing a shape now would pin a fiction. Whoever builds the engine replaces this ref with a real schema.

puzzle.description: One of the seven reusable puzzle types. Each is built once and reskinned per planet — an eighth value here means a one-off that needs its own maintenance forever, so it takes an ADR, never a drive-by edit.

required.description: Does this marker count toward the unlock threshold? Defaults to true. Optional markers award progress but never block: the threshold is computed over solved-and-required markers only, so a level with no required marker at all is rejected by data/scripts/validate-levels.py.

config.description: Puzzle-type-specific settings, constrained per type by the allOf branches above. A type whose engine does not exist yet must carry no config — an authored setting no engine reads looks like it works and does not.

dataRef.description: The seam between Python output and the game: a JSON pointer into a file under data/generated/, e.g. 'orbital-positions.json#/earth'.

unlocks.description: Ids of things in the world that react when this is solved — a path lighting up, a door opening. Each must name something that exists: another marker id in this same level, or a level id that has data committed under src/scenes/. Enforced by data/scripts/validate-levels.py.

fact.description: The short fact shown once the puzzle is solved.
